# O.A.S.I.S.

> Free AI assistant for Windows. Runs open models 100% locally — no cloud, no telemetry, no subscriptions.

## What it is

O.A.S.I.S. is an agentic AI system that runs open models (Llama 3.2, Gemma 4, Qwen 2.5, plus any GGUF) on your own PC. Unlike chat wrappers, it has 80+ built-in tools that let the assistant actually do things: control Windows apps, manage files, run code in an isolated sandbox, search the web, talk and listen in Spanish and English, and maintain persistent memory across sessions.

## Key features

- **100% offline inference** — your data never leaves your machine
- **80+ built-in tools** — system control, files, code sandbox, web search, voice, memory, MCP
- **App control** — open, close, and interact with any Windows app via 5-level fallback chain
- **Skills & Workflows** — custom triggers with multi-step automated routines
- **Voice** — offline STT (speech-to-text) and TTS (text-to-speech)
- **Persistent memory** — ChromaDB + cross-encoder reranking for semantic recall
- **Proactivity engine** — suggests actions, monitors system health, reminds of events
- **MCP client** — connect to external MCP servers for additional capabilities

## Quick start

1. Download the installer from https://github.com/OASISLocal/O.A.S.I.S./releases/latest
2. Run it on Windows 10+ or Windows 11
3. Pick a model from the built-in catalog
4. Start chatting

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended)
- NVIDIA GPU optional (automatic layer offloading)
- No account, no API key, no internet required

## Pricing

Personal plan free forever. OASIS Max is a one-time payment (EUR 15 in early access, EUR 25 at 1.0) with coding, automations, messaging and mobile. No subscriptions. Details: https://oasislocal.github.io/O.A.S.I.S./#pricing
